schema.name: voice-commands
schema.description: Turn a spoken command into a desktop action while the user is still speaking (open apps, play media, type text).
schema.state: The transcript of one spoken command so far, as the speech recogniser streams it: lowercase words, no punctuation.

action.instructions: Which action does the user want the computer to take?

criteria.open_notes: Open the notes or notepad application.
criteria.type_text: Type the dictated text into the app that is currently in focus.
criteria.open_youtube: Open YouTube without playing anything in particular.
criteria.play_youtube: Search for and play a specific video, channel or topic on YouTube.
criteria.open_spotify: Open Spotify without playing anything in particular.
criteria.play_liked_songs: Play the user's own liked or saved songs collection on Spotify.
criteria.play_spotify: Play a specific song, artist, album or playlist on Spotify.
criteria.pause_media: Pause or stop whatever is currently playing.
criteria.resume_media: Resume or continue playback that was paused.
criteria.next_track: Skip to the next track or video.
criteria.volume_up: Make the sound louder by increasing the volume.
criteria.volume_down: Make the sound quieter by decreasing the volume.
criteria.open_browser: Open the web browser without searching for anything.
criteria.search_web: Search the web or look something up online for the user.
criteria.close_app: Close the current window or a named application.
criteria.none: Out of scope: chit-chat, a question, or a request for something the assistant cannot do.

samples.state: open spotify and play some old motown
uh close the uh the browser
type see you at the station at seven

yaml:
# Tez schema (format: docs/API.md, "Schema files"). The 16 actions and descriptions are the measured set in
# data/voice/intents.json. Stream the transcript word by word; a confident "none" on a partial transcript means
# "keep listening", not "do nothing" (BENCHMARKS.md section 3).
name: voice-commands
description: Turn a spoken command into a desktop action while the user is still speaking (open apps, play media, type text).
state: "The transcript of one spoken command so far, as the speech recogniser streams it: lowercase words, no punctuation."
questions:
  action:
    type: choice
    instructions: Which action does the user want the computer to take?
    criteria:
      open_notes: Open the notes or notepad application.
      type_text: Type the dictated text into the app that is currently in focus.
      open_youtube: Open YouTube without playing anything in particular.
      play_youtube: Search for and play a specific video, channel or topic on YouTube.
      open_spotify: Open Spotify without playing anything in particular.
      play_liked_songs: Play the user's own liked or saved songs collection on Spotify.
      play_spotify: Play a specific song, artist, album or playlist on Spotify.
      pause_media: Pause or stop whatever is currently playing.
      resume_media: Resume or continue playback that was paused.
      next_track: Skip to the next track or video.
      volume_up: Make the sound louder by increasing the volume.
      volume_down: Make the sound quieter by decreasing the volume.
      open_browser: Open the web browser without searching for anything.
      search_web: Search the web or look something up online for the user.
      close_app: Close the current window or a named application.
      none: "Out of scope: chit-chat, a question, or a request for something the assistant cannot do."
